title: Check that each roadmap owner file exists
summary: The site checker now fails when a roadmap step names an owner file that is not a file in the repository, with the same path and capitalization rules as evidence references. It also fails when no step names configs/accepted_controller.json as its owner. Without that rule, an edit that pointed the walk and stop step at another owner would skip the judged-row and video-acceptance rule and admit a done marker. The four owner files that the six steps name exist today: robot/active_model.json, configs/approved_code_version.json, configs/accepted_controller.json and configs/walking_requirements.json. Two new tests cover a renamed or deleted owner, a directory, a URL and a walking step with a different owner.
next: Rewrite ARCHITECTURE so that it cites the owner files; then correct the GPS-only line in the navigation guide.
